details:
This update for keepassxc fixes the following issues:

Changes in keepassxc:

- Update to 2.8.0:
  - New features: remote database synchronization and import using
    external tools, configurable keyboard shortcuts, SSH Agent key
    generation (RSA, ECDSA, Ed25519), Wayland Auto-Type via XDG
    Desktop Portals, Quick Unlock using Polkit.
  - Migrate to Qt 6.
  - Security fixes: use-after-free when importing crafted KDB files
    (CVE-2026-69150), entry reference injection and out-of-bounds
    writes in browser integration, integer overflow in the legacy
    KDB importer, protected attributes exposed via Secret Service.
  - Auto-Type plugins are now part of the main binary.
  - Application state is stored in XDG_STATE_HOME.
  - Full changelog: https://github.com/keepassxreboot/keepassxc/blob/2.8.0/CHANGELOG.md
